tasks.name: Fix 1 _format_mem_line None-guard (A2)
tasks.description: main.py _format_mem_line (:120-136) returns 'mem: unavailable' on the daemon host because psutil.process_iter yields memory_info=None for unreadable procs and None.rss raises AttributeError (not in the inner except). Guard `mi = p.info['memory_info']; if mi is None: continue`. Add the missing _format_mem_line unit test, patching psutil ATTRIBUTES (not the module).

steps.description: RED: add test_format_mem_line_skips_unreadable_procs to test_main_validate.py. Patch psutil ATTRIBUTES via patch.object(main_module.psutil, 'virtual_memory'|'swap_memory'|'process_iter', ...) with SimpleNamespace fakes (NOT the whole module — that makes the except tuple Mocks). process_iter yields two: .info={'name':'root-proc','memory_info':None} and .info={'name':'real-proc','memory_info':SimpleNamespace(rss=1*1024**3)}. Assert out.startswith('mem: '), 'free'/'swap'/'real-proc' in out, 'unavailable' not in out.

tasks.name: Fix 2 capture Brain PID before shutdown (D2)
tasks.description: main.py _handle_restart reads _daemon.brain._brain_pid at step 5 (:1272) and step 7 (:1296) AFTER step 4 brain.shutdown() (:1265-1266) cleared it -> _kill_orphan_brains(None). Capture the pid BEFORE step 4 into a local; use it at steps 5+7. No post-shutdown file fallback (BRAIN_PID_FILE removed by shutdown; stale file risks PID recycling). Test lives in test_daemon.py TestHandleRestart (the ONLY safe execvp-patched _handle_restart harness).

steps.description: RED: in test_daemon.py class TestHandleRestart (:1742-1910) add test_handle_restart_captures_brain_pid_before_shutdown, mirroring test_handle_restart_uses_targeted_brain_kill_not_pkill (:1877). MUST patch os.execvp, os.kill, main.subprocess.run (fake stdout=''), main.time.sleep (unpatched execvp replaces the pytest process). mock_daemon.brain._brain_pid=99999; brain.shutdown.side_effect = lambda: setattr(mock_daemon.brain,'_brain_pid',None); patch.object(main,'_kill_orphan_brains') as mock_orphans; patch.object(main,'_logged_kill', side_effect recording (pid,sig)); call main._handle_restart(signal.SIGHUP, None); assert mock_orphans.assert_called_once_with(99999) AND (99999, signal.SIGTERM) in logged.
steps.expected: FAIL (both read _brain_pid after the clear -> _kill_orphan_brains(None), no step-7 kill).

No file fallback (moot post-shutdown + recycling risk).
Verify (existing :1877 stays green — its mock never clears _brain_pid).

tasks.name: Fix 3 idle-TTL polish (obs1/2/3)
tasks.description: _reap_idle_worker: new signature (worker_id, session_name, ssh_host, remote_log_dir, armed); returns bool (True=reaped, False=deferred/aborted); re-reads get_log_mtime ONCE immediately before kill_session and aborts (return False) if fresh>armed+grace (obs2); the check_workers gate continues ONLY when it returns True (obs1: a deferred worker still reaches marker/session-died handling); the reaped Slack/Brain message is neutral about disposition (obs3). Tests must use numeric get_log_mtime values (a bare MagicMock return raises TypeError on the > compare).
